name: Percent change
description: Percentage increase or decrease between two values.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/,(?=\d{3})/g,'');let m=t.match(/from\s*\$?(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:\w+\s+)?to\s*\$?(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);if(!m){const n=t.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g);if(!n||n.length<2)return{answer:null,reason:'Need two values.'};m=[0,n[0],n[1]]}const a=+m[1],b=+m[2];if(a===0)return{answer:null,reason:'The starting value is zero, so a percent change is undefined.'};const p=(b-a)/Math.abs(a)*100,r=+p.toFixed(2);return{answer:`${r>0?'+':''}${r}% (${r>=0?'increase':'decrease'})`,steps:[`Change = ${b} − ${a} = ${+(b-a).toFixed(6)}`,`Percent change = change ÷ |${a}| × 100 = ${r}%`]}}

sales went from 120 to 90, what percent decrease is that
price rose from $3.20 to $4.00 percent change
